content.value: . In an epicyclic gear train of the “sun and planet type" as shown in figure the pitch circle diameter of internally toothed ring D is to be 216 mm and the module 4 mm. When the ring D is stationary the spider A, which carries three planet wheels C of equal size, is to make one revolution in the same sense as the sun wheel B for every five revolution of the driving spindle carrying the sun wheel B. Determine suitable number of teeth for all the wheels and the exact diameter of pitch circle of the ring.
